instruction: Please increase the contrast of my photo on the desktop.

metadata.explanation: Infeasible task variation: Asks to increase contrast of a photo on desktop without proper setup (no photo downloaded/opened). Similar to original task which asks to tone down brightness without setup.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is intentionally marked as infeasible - no photo exists on desktop to increase contrast
The infeasible() evaluator function is semantically correct for this case - it's a placeholder for tasks that cannot be verified
Using infeasible() is the appropriate approach when a task cannot be completed due to missing prerequisites
No verification logic is needed or expected for infeasible tasks
